title: 9 Best Herbal Creams For Bladder Infection
intro: Herbal creams for bladder infection are topical creams that contain natural ingredients derived from plants, such as herbs and botanicals, to help alleviate symptoms of urinary tract infections (UTIs) and bladder infections. These creams have been found to have numerous benefits, including reducing inflammation, soothing discomfort, and promoting healing in the urinary tract. Examples of herbal creams used to treat bladder infections include Uva Ursi cream, which contains arbutin that inhibits the growth of bacteria, and Juniper berry cream, which has anti-inflammatory properties that help reduce swelling and pain. Other herbal creams, such as chamomile and calendula creams, are also used to treat bladder infections due to their soothing and anti-inflammatory effects that help calm the urinary tract and promote healing.
